title: Allahabad HC flags indefinite freezing of bank accounts after cyber fraud
description:
The Allahabad High Court has expressed serious concern over indefinite freezing of bank accounts of people after their identities and personal details are misused by cybercriminals.
A Lucknow bench of justices Rajan Roy and Subhash Vidyarthi on Thursday asked the Centre to devise an effective mechanism to address such cases, observing that gullible citizens should not be left trapped in the aftermath of cybercrimes committed using their details.
The bench impleaded the home ministry in a petition filed by a builder whose bank accounts have remained frozen.
It directed Deputy Solicitor General SB Pandey, appearing for the Union government, to obtain instructions and file an affidavit in response.
The matter will be heard after four weeks.
